description: This file defines the ConfigHelper class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing configuration paths and plugin configurations, as well as providing aggregated configuration data.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Config\ConfigHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing configuration paths, plugin configurations, and other system-wide settings in the OrangeHRM platform.

methods.name: getPathConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves key system path configurations based on the project's directory structure.

methods.name: getPluginConfigs
methods.description: Collects plugin-specific configurations by scanning plugin directories and loading their configuration files.

methods.name: getPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Loads the configuration file for a given plugin directory if present.

methods.name: getClientConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves client-related configuration settings, including paths for client files and Vue build details.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigs
methods.description: Returns globally applicable configuration flags such as internationalization and session timeout settings.

methods.name: getConfigs
methods.description: Aggregates all configuration settings into a single array for use throughout the application.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a specific configuration value by name, with an optional default if not set.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new configuration parameters into the existing settings.
